intro:

What distinguishes Hyderabad is the pharma and life-sciences overlay: companies in Genome Valley run validation-heavy, compliance-bound projects where formal project management is not optional, making PMP particularly valued. Scrum roles grow with every new GCC announcement. Our weekend live online batch runs on Indian Standard Time, so you train from home over two days without touching the working week. Class discussion covers scenarios Hyderabad professionals recognise: regulated-industry documentation, captive-centre reporting lines, platform migrations. After the workshop you get exam application support built for high-audit-risk applications, mock exams, and trainer access until you clear.

Hyderabad is compounding faster than any other Indian tech hub, and HITEC City and Gachibowli floors show it: global capability centres are moving from support work to product ownership, which means more Scrum teams, more release governance and more demand for certified leads. Pharma and life-sciences majors headquartered in the city run validation-heavy projects where documented methodology is non-negotiable. Training runs live in IST, so a Hyderabad professional finishes the entire course over one weekend without leave. The salary table below carries Hyderabad-specific sourced figures — useful ammunition in a market where offers move quickly — and the employer list names the kind of companies hiring here. For teams inside a Hyderabad GCC or pharma IT wing, private cohorts run on your schedule.
